purpose: Execute coordinator-authorized continuous paths through actual ROS2 Jazzy Nav2 FollowPath; never assign tasks or generate a fleet route

authorized_path.semantics: Replacement cancels old FollowPath action before starting a new one. Empty path revokes motion. Trusted coordinator interface; topic alone is not an ownership certificate.

sim/obstacle.semantics: true inserts a stationary 8cm radius obstacle 36cm ahead of current robot, false removes it

output.execution_status: std_msgs/msg/String JSON; authorized/executing/finished/revoked; Nav2 action status and error_code
output.scan: sensor_msgs/msg/LaserScan from ideal ray casting, 361 beams
output.imu: sensor_msgs/msg/Imu ideal angular rate and body acceleration

actuation: Nav2 controller_server -> cmd_vel_nav -> actual nav2_collision_monitor -> cmd_vel -> kinematic base; stale final command stops after 0.3s
localization: Actual robot_localization EKF fuses ideal wheel velocity and IMU angular velocity/acceleration. Static map->odom transform anchors known simulation origin. No AMCL/SLAM or physical localization claim.
limits: Continuous three-robot development smoke, not a fresh multi-seed throughput acceptance
Lockstep simulated clock pauses during cell execution; ownership leases are logical, not asynchronous hardware leases
No physical sensors, edge hardware, Gazebo, traction/slip/noise or safety certification
Dynamic grid block control rejected in Nav2 mode until physical-map update propagation is implemented; transient lidar obstacle fixture tested
Mid-cell fault requires stop/relocalization/restart, not automatic cargo or physical recovery
Trusted local authorized-path and executor HTTP interfaces; no hostile-client security claim
Three-robot deployment currently uses fixed development origins matched to launch; general warehouse deployment configuration remains work

fleet.controllers: Three independent Node EdgePeer controllers with ROS2/Fast DDS allocation and intent traffic
fleet.namespace: AMR_01, AMR_02, AMR_03; tf and tf_static remapped into each namespace, frame names scoped by isolated TF buses
fleet.physicalWorld: Shared /fleet/physical_poses; transformed into peer lidar circles. Initial WarehouseMap cells become identical global rectangles transformed into each local map/costmap. Ideal physics does not repair overlaps.
fleet.coordinates: 0.6 metres per grid cell, per-robot map origin at initial cell; scenario fixture and simulator origins must match
fleet.commit: Confirm locally negotiated decision, await actual Nav2 FollowPath terminal success plus fresh EKF endpoint within 0.09m, then settle logical pose/task. No teleportation on failure.
fleet.failure: 2s wall-clock Node heartbeat expiry requests Nav2 cancellation. Failed/cancelled/partial execution latches, retains measured pose and leaves logical tick uncommitted. Cancellation unconfirmed is explicitly reported as a physical execution fault; no physical-stop claim.
fleet.http: Trusted loopback per-robot ports19700..19702, not exposed remote control/security boundary
fleet.demo: NAV2_FLEET_DEMO=1 bash scripts/nav2-fleet-acceptance.sh /tmp/nav2-demo; then FLEET_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4011 npm run dev
